	@Value
	public static class ItemOption
	{
		int itemId;
		boolean membersOnly;
		Map<Skill, Integer> skillRequirements;
		boolean satisfiesFullQuantity;
		boolean combinedUpgrade;

		public boolean isUsableBy(PlayerLoadoutSnapshot snapshot)
		{
			if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.isLoggedIn())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (membersOnly && !snapshot.isMembersWorld())
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (Map.Entry<Skill, Integer> entry : skillRequirements.entrySet())
			{
				if (snapshot.getSkillLevel(entry.getKey()) < entry.getValue())
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	private static final Map<String, ItemGroup> BY_NAME;
	private static final Map<Integer, ItemGroup> PRIMARY_GROUP_BY_ITEM;

	static
	{
		Map<String, ItemGroup> byName = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Integer, ItemGroup> byItem = new HashMap<>();
		for (ItemGroup group : values())
		{
			byName.put(group.name(), group);
			// Skip composite umbrella groups, outfits, and combat armor ladders when reverse-mapping captures
			// so user loadout snapshots keep exact gear pieces while smart-grouping supplies and tools.
			if (group == COMBAT_BOOST || group == EMERGENCY_TELEPORT || group == SPEC_WEAPON
				|| group == FISHING_TOOL || group == HUNTER_TOOL || group == WINTERTODT_FOOD
				|| group.name().endsWith("_OUTFIT") || group == RAIMENTS_OF_THE_EYE
				|| group.name().startsWith("MELEE_") || group.name().startsWith("RANGED_") || group.name().startsWith("MAGIC_"))
			{
				continue;
			}
			for (int id : group.itemIds)
			{
				byItem.putIfAbsent(id, group);
			}
		}
		BY_NAME = Collections.unmodifiableMap(byName);
		PRIMARY_GROUP_BY_ITEM = Collections.unmodifiableMap(byItem);
	}

	private final String displayName;
	private final int iconItemId;
	private final List<ItemOption> options;
	private final Set<Integer> itemIds;
	private final Set<Integer> fullSatisfyItemIds;
	private final Map<Integer, ItemOption> optionById;

	ItemGroup(String displayName, int iconItemId, List<ItemOption> options)
	{
		this.displayName = displayName;
		this.iconItemId = iconItemId;
		this.options = options;
		Set<Integer> ids = new LinkedHashSet<>(options.size() * 2);
		Set<Integer> unlimited = new LinkedHashSet<>();
		Map<Integer, ItemOption> byId = new HashMap<>(options.size() * 2);
		for (ItemOption opt : options)
		{
			ids.add(opt.getItemId());
			if (opt.isSatisfiesFullQuantity())
			{
				unlimited.add(opt.getItemId());
			}
			byId.putIfAbsent(opt.getItemId(), opt);
		}
		this.itemIds = Collections.unmodifiableSet(ids);
		this.fullSatisfyItemIds = Collections.unmodifiableSet(unlimited);
		this.optionById = Collections.unmodifiableMap(byId);
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the highest-ranked usable item ID present in {@code poolCounts}, or -1 if none found.
	 */
	public int bestUsableInPool(PlayerLoadoutSnapshot snapshot, Map<Integer, Integer> poolCounts)
	{
		if (poolCounts == null || poolCounts.isEmpty())
		{
			return -1;
		}
		for (ItemOption opt : options)
		{
			if (opt.isUsableBy(snapshot) && poolCounts.getOrDefault(opt.getItemId(), 0) > 0)
			{
				return opt.getItemId();
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the highest-ranked item ID present in {@code poolCounts} regardless of level check
	 * (useful when the player already equipped or carried an item via boost/quest exception).
	 */
	public int bestAnyInPool(Map<Integer, Integer> poolCounts)
	{
		if (poolCounts == null || poolCounts.isEmpty())
		{
			return -1;
		}
		for (ItemOption opt : options)
		{
			if (poolCounts.getOrDefault(opt.getItemId(), 0) > 0)
			{
				return opt.getItemId();
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the highest-ranked usable base item ID for the account's live levels & world status,
	 * skipping combined/rare upgrades unless the player actually owns them.
	 */
	public int bestUsableTheoretical(PlayerLoadoutSnapshot snapshot)
	{
		for (ItemOption opt : options)
		{
			if (!opt.isCombinedUpgrade() && opt.isUsableBy(snapshot))
			{
				return opt.getItemId();
			}
		}
		for (ItemOption opt : options)
		{
			if (opt.isUsableBy(snapshot))
			{
				return opt.getItemId();
			}
		}
		return iconItemId;
	}

	/**
	 * Collects usable item IDs from {@code bankCounts} in BiS order up to covering {@code missingQty}.
	 * Optionally excludes item IDs already equipped (useful for multi-piece outfits).
	 */
	public List<Integer> selectBestBankHighlightIds(
		PlayerLoadoutSnapshot snapshot,
		Map<Integer, Integer> bankCounts,
		Set<Integer> excludeIds,
		int missingQty,
		boolean bestOwnedOnly)
	{
		List<Integer> selected = new ArrayList<>();
		if (bestOwnedOnly && bankCounts != null && !bankCounts.isEmpty())
		{
			int covered = 0;
			for (ItemOption opt : options)
			{
				int id = opt.getItemId();
				if (!opt.isUsableBy(snapshot) || (excludeIds != null && excludeIds.contains(id)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int qtyInBank = bankCounts.getOrDefault(id, 0);
				if (qtyInBank > 0)
				{
					selected.add(id);
					if (opt.isSatisfiesFullQuantity())
					{
						return selected;
					}
					covered += qtyInBank;
					if (covered >= missingQty)
					{
						return selected;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (!selected.isEmpty())
		{
			return selected;
		}
		for (ItemOption opt : options)
		{
			int id = opt.getItemId();
			if (opt.isUsableBy(snapshot) && (excludeIds == null || !excludeIds.contains(id)))
			{
				selected.add(id);
			}
		}
		return selected;
	}
